first_impression: A polished Material canvas demo with zoom controls, Reset, and a Try Material entry point; the canvas itself is initially sparse.
after_state: The demo navigated to a Material sign-in page offering Continue with Google. No personal data or login was entered.
notes: The public demo presents the canvas concept, but the main app workflow is gated behind sign-in.

first_impression: A project gallery lists four math canvases—Gamma Function, Tiny Transformer, Olympiad Geometry, and Simplex and Partitions—with New project and a 48-tool WebMCP inspector.
action_attempted: Clicked Open Olympiad Geometry from the project gallery.
after_state: The gallery remained unchanged and the project did not visibly open.
notes: Projects and native inspector are clearly exposed, but the tested project-open action produced no visible transition.

first_impression: A War Council operation-selection screen presents medieval RTS scenarios, difficulty choices, and a Begin Battle control; the central game purpose is immediately clear.
action_attempted: Clicked Begin Battle for the default Bridge of Knives operation.
after_state: The app opened the battlefield with six army groups totaling 1,520 troops, regiment controls, speed controls, a minimap, and a battle status panel.
notes: The live RTS battlefield and structured regiment controls are usable without login.

first_impression: An accessibility-focused interactive lab explains that approval changes agent tools, with baseline trial, preference controls, tuning tabs, and an explicit APPLY ABSENT state.
after_state: The interface remained on the baseline screen; the baseline-trial button stayed present and movement controls remained disabled.
notes: The approval/tool-state concept is visible, but the attempted baseline action showed no observable progress.

first_impression: A signed-in-looking MCPx Runtime Control Plane shows Acme/Production, service/workflow/transaction navigation, and Happy Path and Challenge Mode run controls.
after_state: The button changed to disabled Executing Pipeline… and an audit log appeared with TX_CREATED, indicating the workflow started but had not completed during observation.
notes: The runtime ledger and pipeline execution state were directly visible; no credentials were requested.

first_impression: An organic chemistry workspace starts with an SN2 hydroxide/bromide exercise, atom/bond/lone-pair selectors, disabled checking/commit controls, and links to an agent lab and drawing mode.
after_state: The workspace remained on the same exercise; no agent-lab panel or navigation became visible.
notes: The learner-controlled mechanism workflow and sealed initial draft are clear, but the agent-lab link did not visibly respond.
